origin.description: The user explicitly requires architectural choices, rejected options and reasons to survive, and requests useful harness practices be assimilated without flattening Projector into instructions.
Motivating integration evidence; not authority for Projector-specific design or claimed implementation.

payload.statement: Report finite observed coverage populations and distinguish mapping from fulfillment. Preserve accepted capabilities before implementation exists. Rank concrete unresolved obligations and repair questions using observed effect and blocking status, with stable issue identity and state-bound evidence. Accepted meaning, satisfied predicates or an explicit valid deferral may settle an issue; relevant new facts reopen it without reopening unrelated decisions. A cleanup plan must identify actionable repairs and cannot claim execution or a complete design from unavailable evidence.
payload.title: Expose remaining design obligations progressively
